title: Tiny, cute light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='30' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- Bulb glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Glass highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='34' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#fffbe6' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Inner filament glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='11' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- Filament -->
  <path d='M43 50 Q46 42 50 46 Q54 50 57 42' stroke='#ff8800' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Filament supports -->
  <line x1='43' y1='50' x2='43' y2='56' stroke='#ff8800' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='50' x2='57' y2='56' stroke='#ff8800' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Screw base -->
  <rect x='40' y='64' width='20' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  <rect x='39' y='70' width='22' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a8a8a8'/>
  <rect x='40' y='76' width='20' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a8a8a8'/>
  <!-- Base bottom tip -->
  <rect x='46' y='86' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#909090'/>
  <!-- Cute face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#5a3e00'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#5a3e00'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 51 54 47' stroke='#5a3e00' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
